environmental.acoustic-noise: 77.6 dBA at low fan RPM (3300), 91.7 at high (6000), 99.6 at full (7900), with PEM-3s and Enhanced Fan Trays
environmental.altitude: 60 m below to 1800 m above sea level at 40 C; 1800 to 4000 m at 30 C
environmental.operating-temp: 5 C to 40 C; short-term -5 C to 55 C

power.power-input-ac: none on the chassis; an external split rectifier shelf (OmniOn L21 3HE20676AA, Eltek HM34J) feeds the PEM-3 terminals
power.power-input-dc: -40 to -72 VDC into two DC PEM-3 (100 A breaker each), one -48 V / RTN pair per PEM-3; one PEM-3 carries the system, two give redundancy
power.power-max-scope: heat dissipation with worst-case IOM and MDAs (SR-7 guide p94 Table 29)
power.rated-voltage-dc: -40 to -72 VDC; PEM-3 4000 W at -40 to -72 VDC, 4600 W at -46 to -72 VDC

configs.description: The population SR-7 guide p49 Figure 6 draws: IOM3-XP cards in slots 1, 2 and 4, slot impedance panels in 3 and 5, and SF/CPM4-7 in A and B. The figure's MDAs are not modelled yet (slot 1 two five-port cards, slot 2 two ten-port RJ45 cards, slot 4 MDA 2 a twenty-port RJ45 card), so every IOM3-XP MDA slot shows the classic MDA impedance panel, which is what slot 4 MDA 1 carries in the figure (Table key 7). These are the bay defaults.
configs.name: as-drawn

configs.description: The chassis as it ships and powers on (SR-7 guide p93 note 8: shipped with the Enhanced Fan Tray, the air filter tray, impedance panels, two DC PEM-3s and the power supply filters installed): both PEM-3s and filters, the fan tray, the air filter, an SF/CPM4-7 in A and B, and every IOM/IMM slot closed by a slot impedance panel.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The front as SR-7 guide p50 Figure 7 draws the 7450 ESS-7: the safety panel mounted over both power supply filter bays.
configs.name: safety-cover

airflow.note: p82: "The chassis has a right-side air intake and a rear air exhaust"; air crosses the line cards from the filtered right-side vent and leaves through the rear fan tray. p113 asks for 3 in of clearance at the right side for the intake.

card-cage.note: Seven horizontal slots on the family's slot unit U = 35.4 from y 23.6: the slot tops read along x 100 at 22.6-24.3, 58.2, 92.8-93.8, 129.4, 165.0, 200.7 and 236.2 and the stack's bottom at 271.4, a mean pitch of 35.4 (the conventions measured the same). Every bay is 425.4 x 35.4 at x 17.2; the drawn cards span x 16.3-443.5, stroke included. p48: "The module slots are horizontally oriented ... MDA slot 1 (left slot)", so no bay rotates.

chassis.note: p93 Table 28: 14 x 17.5 x 25.5 in (35.56 x 44.45 x 64.77 cm) H x W x D; about 34 kg empty, 41 kg with the factory-installed parts (Enhanced Fan Tray, air filter tray, impedance panels, two DC PEM-3s and the power supply filters), up to 70 kg loaded; the mounting brackets are factory-installed for MID-mounting (p48, p93). 8 RU. Ears are not modelled: the face is the 444.5 between the folds.

colour.note: No photograph of an SR-7 is staged. The charcoal bezel, the black numeral boxes and the white print are taken from the SR-12 lab photographs (the same family and era) and from the figure, whose boxes are drawn black. See gap photographs.

defaults.note: Bay defaults follow Figure 6 with current-generation stand-ins: the figure draws IOM3-XP cards with classic MDAs in slots 1, 2 and 4 (key 5) and impedance panels in 3 and 5 (key 6), and SF/CPM4 in A and B. Slots 1, 2 and 4 default to nokia/iom3-xp@1. Its MDA slots carry the classic MDA impedance panel by the carrier's own default, which is what key 7 draws in slot 4 MDA 1; the figure's other classic MDAs are not modelled yet. A and B default to nokia/sfm4-7@1.

esd.note: p50 Table 3 key 3, the ESD plug receptacle: a hex-faced jack at the bottom of the slot strip, centre (8.3, 262.1) on p49, under the ESD awareness mark (a hand over an earth symbol, y 232.9-240) printed above the B box. Drawn with common/esd-jack@1.

filter-bays.note: p48: "Below slot B are two power supply filter bays that house two DC Power Supply Filters". The filter plates measure x 4.3-222.6 and 223.8-441.7, y 283.6-348.0 on p49 (the conventions' figures), so the bays are 218.2 x 64.5 at x 4.3 and 223.6. The band between the cage and the filters (y 271.4-283.3) carries two round fasteners, at (14.0, 277.7) and (431.9, 277.7). p50 Figure 7 (the ESS-7) draws one safety panel across the whole lower front, 444.5 x 84.0 from the bottom of slot B (y 271.6) to the chassis foot, covering the band and both bays; it is modelled as the optional nokia/sr-7-psf-safety-panel@1, mounted only in the safety-cover configuration.

legend.note: p49: "7750 SR-7" over "Service Router" at the top left above slot 1, x 21.6, baselines 10.3 and 14.9, cap heights about 5.7 and 2.6 mm. The ESS-7 of p50 Figure 7 prints "Ethernet Service Switch" instead. The text is set in the bezel colour's contrast, white.

other-faces.note: Nothing draws a side, the top or the bottom in elevation. p125 Figure 25 and p128 Figure 27 are isometrics: the latter shows the ground receptacles on the left side near the front and on the top, and the right side carries the air intake (p82).

panel-scale.note: Gate 1. p49 Figure 6 at 600 dpi: the body folds at px 305.5 and 3015.5, 2710 px = 444.5 mm at 6.097 px/mm, and top to bottom 2166 px = 355.3 mm against the stated 355.6 (the conventions measured 6.098 across and 6.097 down): orthographic to 0.1 percent. Face frame x = (px - 305.5) / 6.097, y = (px - 69) / 6.097. p51 Figure 8: folds at px 264 and 2973.5, 6.096 px/mm, top at px 125, bottom 355.6. Positions read off row and column profiles and a 5 mm grid on the renders, good to about 0.5 mm.

power.note: p94 Table 29: heat dissipation "with worst-case IOM and MDAs" 3750 J/s (12 795 BTU/hr), carried as power-max-w with envelope fully-configured; the system safety rating maximum is 4000 J/s with PEM-3s (13 648 BTU/hr) and 2400 J/s with the older PEMs (8189 BTU/hr). DC only: -40 to -72 VDC into two load-sharing PEM-3s, each with one -48 V / RTN terminal pair behind a cover and a 100 A breaker; one PEM carries the full system, two give redundancy (p72). PEM-3 100A: 4000 W at -40 to -72 V, 4600 W at -46 to -72 V (p95 Table 31). Each PEM-3 connects internally to its own front power supply filter (p72 Figure 12). AC sites use one split external rectifier shelf with two 5 kW outputs, the OmniOn L21 3HE20676AA or the Eltek HM34J (p75-76).

rear.note: p51 Figure 8 as seen from behind: the air filter tray faceplate at the left (x 7.55-74.55, y 1.3-306.9; drawn 67.5 wide), the Enhanced Fan Tray beside it (x 75.2-438.4, y 0.9-305.7; drawn 364.1 wide; the tray is stated 12.0 H x 14.3 W in, p106), and PEM 1 at the LEFT and PEM 2 at the right (keys 4 and 5) along the bottom. The drawn PEM plate runs y 307.8-351.8, 44.0 tall against the stated 42.7 (p107), so the bays centre the stated 219.5 x 42.7 on it at y 308.45-351.15 (310.0 is the terminal-block top, not the plate top). The "-48 / RTN / TORQUE 40 lbs-inch" text belongs to the PEM-3 plates. No rear ground point is drawn; the ground receptacles are on the left side and the top (p128 Figure 27).

slot-numbering.note: p48: the top slots 1 through 5 are reserved for IOMs; the two bottom module slots, A and B, for the SF/CPMs. The chassis prints 1-5, A and B in white on black boxes down the strip left of the cage (x 4.3-12.0, each about 7.5 tall), read on p49 at y 29.9, 64.9, 101.5, 136.8, 173.2, 208.5 and 244.9 - each a few millimetres below its slot's top edge, the offset growing from 6.3 to 8.9 down the stack, as drawn. rel-pos is the printed number for the card slots and 1 = A, 2 = B for the SF/CPM slots.

sources.note: Written first. 7450 ESS-7 and 7750 SR-7 Chassis Installation Guide 22.7, 3HE18643AAAATQZZA03 (the SR-7 guide; pages are the printed numbers, which are also the PDF pages): p49 Figure 6 (front), p50 Figure 7 (front of the ESS-7 with the safety cover) and p51 Figure 8 (rear) are the geometry, p47-48 the models and slot rules, p72-76 power, p82 airflow, p93-94 Tables 28-29 the chassis and environmental specifications, p111 storage, p125 and p128 the rack mounting and grounding isometrics. The figures are VECTOR (pdfimages -list on p49-55 finds only small icons), so a 600 dpi pdftocairo render is exact. No photograph of an SR-7 is staged. The A02 edition is paginated differently and is not cited.
